title: On the maximal run-length function in the Lüroth expansion
summary: Let \( \ell_n(x) \) denote the maximal run-length among the first \( n \) digits of the Lüroth expansion of \( x\in(0,1] \). While \( \ell_n(x) \) grows logarithmically, we investigate the finer multifractal properties of the exceptional set where $\ell_n(x)$ exhibits linear growth. Specifically, we establish the Hausdorff dimension of the set \[ \left\{ x \in (0,1] : \liminf_{n \to \infty} \frac{\ell_n(x)}{n} = α, \; \limsup_{n \to \infty} \frac{\ell_n(x)}{n} = β\right\}, \] for all \( 0 \le α\le β\le 1 \).
